The '''Drift Hills Republic Hangar''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] built in the [[Northern Snowdrift Hills]] of the [[Clabburn Tundra]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]].
